Common.name: Backup Secretary
Common.desc: If you control a Cyberse monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Backup Secretary" once per turn this way.

Common.name: Battle Fader
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, then end the Battle Phase. If Summoned this way, banish it when it leaves the field.

Common.name: Beast King Barbaros
Common.desc: You can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing, but its original ATK becomes 1900. You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way: Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

Common.name: Bitron
Common.desc: A new species found in electronic space. There's not much information on it.

Common.name: Bitrooper
Common.desc: You can send 1 Level 2 or lower monster from your hand to the GY; Special Summon this card from your hand. You can only use this effect of "Bitrooper" once per turn.

Common.name: Book of Moon
Common.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

Common.name: Bottomless Trap Hole
Common.desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.

Common.name: Burden of the Mighty
Common.desc: Each face-up monster your opponent controls loses 100 ATK x its own Level.

Common.name: Call of the Haunted
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Common.name: Card Trader
Common.desc: Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: You can shuffle 1 card from your hand into the Deck; draw 1 card.

Common.name: Cliant
Common.desc: While this Normal Summoned/Set card is face-up on the field, all Cyberse monsters you control gain 500 ATK/DEF during your turn only. If this card on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can destroy 1 Cyberse monster in your hand or face-up field instead.

Common.name: Compulsory Evacuation Device
Common.desc: Target 1 monster on the field; return that target to the hand.

Common.name: Cyber Dragon
Common.desc: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

Common.name: Cynet Regression
Common.desc: If you Special Summon a Link Monster(s): Target 1 card on the field; destroy it, then draw 1 card. You can only activate 1 "Cynet Regression" per turn.

Common.name: Cynet Universe
Common.desc: All Link Monsters you control gain 300 ATK. Once per turn: You can target 1 monster in the GY; shuffle it into the Deck. If this card on the field is destroyed by a card effect: Send all monsters in the Extra Monster Zones to the GY.

Common.name: Dark Hole
Common.desc: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Common.name: Decode Talker
Common.desc:
2+ Effect Monsters
Gains 500 ATK for each monster it points to. When your opponent activates a card or effect that targets a card(s) you control (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 monster this card points to; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

Common.name: Ego Boost
Common.desc: When a monster declares an attack: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 1000 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase.

Common.name: Evilswarm Mandragora
Common.desc: If your opponent controls more monsters than you do, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

Common.name: Exarion Universe
Common.desc: During your Battle Step, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster: You can make this card lose exactly 400 ATK, and if it does, it will inflict piercing battle damage. These effects last until the end of this turn.

Common.name: Flamvell Guard
Common.desc: A Flamvell guardian who commands fire with his will. His magma-hot barrier protects his troops from intruders.

Common.name: Launcher Commander
Common.desc: All other Cyberse monsters you control gain 300 ATK/DEF. Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 Cyberse monster, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; destroy it.

Common.name: Leotron
Common.desc: A territorial electronic monster that guards its own domain.

Common.name: Link Spider
Common.desc:
1 Normal Monster
Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower Normal Monster from your hand to your zone this card points to.

Common.name: Linkslayer
Common.desc: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can discard up to 2 cards, then target that many Spells/Traps on the field; destroy them.

Common.name: Linkuriboh
Common.desc:
1 Level 1 Monster
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Tribute this card; change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0, until the end of this turn. If this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 Level 1 monster; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Linkuriboh" once per turn.

Common.name: Marshmallon
Common.desc: Cannot be destroyed by battle. After damage calculation, if this card was attacked, and was face-down at the start of the Damage Step: The attacking player takes 1000 damage.

Common.name: Mirror Force
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

Common.name: Monster Reborn
Common.desc: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it.

Common.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
Common.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

Common.name: RAM Clouder
Common.desc: You can Tribute 1 monster, then target 1 Cyberse monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can only use this effect of "RAM Clouder" once per turn.

Common.name: Ryko, Lightsworn Hunter
Common.desc:
FLIP: Apply these effects (simultaneously).
● You can destroy 1 card on the field.
● Send the top 3 cards of your Deck to the GY.

Common.name: Scapegoat
Common.desc: Special Summon 4 "Sheep Tokens" (Beast/EARTH/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

Common.name: Shadow Spell
Common.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; it loses 700 ATK, also it cannot attack or change its battle position. When it leaves the field, destroy this card.

Common.name: Supply Squad
Common.desc: Once per turn, if a monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or card effect: Draw 1 card.

Common.name: Swift Scarecrow
Common.desc: When an opponent's monster declares a direct attack (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; negate the attack, then end the Battle Phase.

Common.name: Texchanger
Common.desc: Once per turn, when your monster is targeted for an attack: You can negate that attack, then Special Summon 1 Cyberse Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY.

Common.name: Torrential Tribute
Common.desc: When a monster(s) is Summoned: Destroy all monsters on the field.

Common.name: United We Stand
Common.desc: The equipped monster gains 800 ATK/DEF for each face-up monster you control.

Common.name: Zero Gravity
Common.desc: Change the battle positions of all face-up monsters on the field.

Ultra Rare.name: Cyberse White Hat
Ultra Rare.desc: If you control 2 or more monsters with the same Type, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). You can only Special Summon "Cyberse White Hat" once per turn this way. If this card is sent to the GY as Link Material: You can make all monsters your opponent currently controls lose 1000 ATK until the end of this turn.

Ultra Rare.name: Transcode Talker
Ultra Rare.desc:
2+ Effect Monsters
While this card is co-linked, it and its co-linked monsters gain 500 ATK, also your opponent cannot target any of them with card effects. You can target 1 Link-3 or lower Cyberse Link Monster in your GY, except "Transcode Talker"; Special Summon it to your zone this card points to. You cannot Special Summon monsters the turn you activate this effect, except Cyberse monsters. You can only use this effect of "Transcode Talker" once per turn.

Super Rare.name: Cynet Recovery
Super Rare.desc: If a Link Monster(s) you control is destroyed by battle or an opponent's card effect: You can target 1 monster in your GY, except a Link Monster; Special Summon it in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Cynet Recovery" once per turn.

Super Rare.name: Pentestag
Super Rare.desc:
2 Effect Monsters
If your linked monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

Super Rare.name: Widget Kid
Super Rare.desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Cyberse monster from your hand in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Widget Kid" once per turn.
